oracle.environment: Disposable loopback-only runtime on port 29423, empty project directory, no site project and no C-Bus endpoint. Synthetic PROGRAMMER names and no-work/TEST-only task groups were used.

parent_help: 101-Help:  DEPLOY_QUEUE ADD - Adds a programmer/task group into deployment queue
101-Help:  DEPLOY_QUEUE DELETE - Deletes programmer entry from queue.
101-Help:  DEPLOY_QUEUE DELETE_ALL - Deletes pending programmer entries from queue.
101-Help:  DEPLOY_QUEUE LIST - List of task groups in queue with short summary.
101 Help:  DEPLOY_QUEUE RETRY - Retry programmer entry from queue.

ADD: Adds existing programmer with specified name into deployment queue.
DELETE: Deletes the programmer with specified name from queue and releases its resources.
DELETE_ALL: Deletes all of specified task group type.
LIST: Lists registered task groups with status summary.
RETRY: Reinits the programmer with specified name from queue and re-adds it into the queue.

event_envelopes.debug: cmqttd publishes a structured first-fault diagnostic containing instruction id/type, status, receipt text and explicit-retry identity; it never claims vendor diagnostic-string equivalence.
event_envelopes.json_object_member_order: Both name-then-msg and msg-then-name were observed across clean native daemon starts; consumers compare JSON semantics, not map member order.
event_envelopes.cross_channel_order: asynchronous and not guaranteed by native scheduling

safe_runtime_observations.empty_programmer: ADD emitted updated/started/ended and reached STOPPED without a C-Bus endpoint.
safe_runtime_observations.fully_cancelled_programmer: A PROGRAMMER TEST instruction cancelled before ADD emitted updated/started/ended, reached STOPPED with remainingSeconds 0, and contacted no C-Bus endpoint.
safe_runtime_observations.test_only_programmer: A three-second PROGRAMMER TEST moved RUNNING to STOPPED and remainingSeconds 3,2,1,0 without a C-Bus endpoint.
safe_runtime_observations.completed_bulk_delete: Two no-work entries produced two ordered 120-deleted rows and removeAllCompletedTaskGroups: 2.
safe_runtime_observations.direct_registry_delete: PROGRAMMER DELETE returned 200 while DEPLOY_QUEUE LIST retained the completed task group; individual queue delete then failed programmer lookup.
safe_runtime_observations.direct_start: PROGRAMMER TRIGGER START returned 200 immediately; a TEST-only task remained RUNNING while remainingSeconds counted 3,2,1,0.
safe_runtime_observations.explicit_retry: RETRY returned 200, refreshed createdTime/startedTime and re-ran the completed TEST-only task asynchronously.

cmqttd_boundaries.ADD: Validates and registers an INIT task group, acknowledges immediately, then runs TEST and retained PP/DALI instructions through the shared service backends; the first fault ends the task in ERROR and is never replayed automatically.
cmqttd_boundaries.DELETE: Terminal local queue entries can be removed without PCI I/O.
cmqttd_boundaries.DELETE_ALL: Volatile queue entries can be selected and removed without PCI I/O.
cmqttd_boundaries.LIST: Returns the volatile queue only; PROGRAMMER registry entries outside the queue are not listed.
cmqttd_boundaries.RETRY: Validates queued terminal state, reinits the task group and re-executes only after the explicit RETRY request; no automatic retry occurs after a fault.
cmqttd_boundaries.events: updated-entries, started and ended are emitted for queue transitions; debug carries a structured cmqttd first-fault receipt without claiming native message text.
cmqttd_boundaries.persistence: PROGRAMMER and DEPLOY_QUEUE state is runtime-only and absent after restart.
cmqttd_boundaries.mqtt: Queue commands share cmqttd's command service and do not take over or open another PCI; MQTT bridging remains active.
